diocesanAffiliation.see: St. Paul's Cathedral, Issele-Uku, Delta State, Nigeria
diocesanAffiliation.bishop: Most Rev. Dr. Michael Odogwu Elue
diocesanAffiliation.dean: Very Rev. Fr. Dean of Asaba Deanery

clergy.name: Rev. Fr. Emmanuel Okonkwo
clergy.bio: Ordained to the Catholic priesthood for the Catholic Diocese of Issele-Uku. He possesses deep pastoral zeal for liturgical renewal, youth development, catechetical formation, and grassroots community evangelization in Ugbolu. He holds licentiate degrees in Pastoral Theology and Sacred Scripture.
clergy.duties: Overall pastoral shepherding, sacramental administration, Parish Pastoral Council headship, and spiritual father to all parishioners.

clergy.name: Rev. Fr. Augustine Nwabuokei
clergy.bio: Ordained for the Catholic Diocese of Issele-Uku, Fr. Augustine oversees youth apostolates, altar servers, Holy Childhood Association (HCA), and liturgical music ministry. He is passionate about faith formation, digital evangelization, and sports ministry.
clergy.duties: Chaplain to CYON, Altar Servers, and HCA; celebration of Daily Masses; hospital and prison visitation apostolate.

pastoralStaff.name: Bro. Dominic Osagie
pastoralStaff.description: Directs the parish catechetical school, infant baptism preparation, RCIA, and sacramental registers.

pastoralStaff.name: Sir (Engr.) Patrick Elumelu, KSM
pastoralStaff.description: Liaison between the lay faithful, pious societies, and the parish clergy; coordinates major church developments.

pastoralStaff.name: Lady Beatrice Nwanze
pastoralStaff.description: Oversees parish administrative documentation, minutes, and communication with diocesan secretariats.
